prompt: Flat sticker illustration of a real Japanese object, simple and clean: thick uniform dark chocolate brown outlines (#4A2219) around every shape, flat solid fills, rounded soft shapes, no gradients, no texture, no shading, no highlights, no drop shadow. Color the object in its real natural colors, slightly softened and warm, using as few colors as possible. Never rainbow or multicolor: parts of the same kind share the same color. No decorative colored balls, dots or confetti. No bright green, no crimson or magenta, no purple. Subject: One single piece of octopus nigiri sushi: a slice of boiled octopus tentacle with a soft orange-red outer skin edge and a white inner cut face, three small round suction cup bumps along the skin edge, laid over an oval block of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate, no blue, no purple, nothing else. Single isolated object, centered, generous empty margin around it. The object is not a character: it has no face, no eyes, no mouth, no blush. No ground shadow, no floor, no character, no animal, no creature, no head under it, no hands, no color swatches, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo. Plain solid flat light gray background filling the whole image.
